hooks.name: test-companion
hooks.description: Keep the pytest suite in step with the service the agent edits.

action.prompt: The agent just changed a file under src/. Update or create the matching test in tests/ so it covers the new behaviour - changes under src/orders/ belong in tests/test_service.py, changes under src/loyalty/ belong in tests/test_loyalty.py. Create the test file if it does not exist yet. Do not touch unrelated tests and do not weaken an existing assertion to make it pass.
